purpose: Independent module/interface inventory for behavioral-emulation registry; no production/source edits and no implementation/PASS claims.
source_priority: STACK.md is the source of truth; the v2.1 changes are recorded in STACK.md (detail in build/12-revision-v2.1.md).
Final design/E1..E5.json graphs define the current refs/nets/pins and must match STACK.md; a mismatch is a graph error or an open item, not an override.
Component catalogue is historical supporting research; alternatives/spares/bench items are not automatically installed.
Actual software/model test coverage must come from domain implementations and tests, not this inventory.
critical_constraints: Every one of the 750 source component references is assigned exactly once to a circuit assembly. Circuit passives remain parameters, not fictitious software registers.
Analog power and RF assemblies need state, fault and connectivity models; they do not automatically have a vendor command protocol.
Declare the boundary: project packet or native API behavior can be modeled without emulating complete vendor firmware, USB descriptors, FPGA/MMIO, analog transients or RF physics.
Known functional terminal names are distinct from qualified physical connector numbering. The received module revision, cable orientation and continuity gates remain explicit.

Daly U101 has no UART or I2C interface in the final graph. Raw pack B0/E1_CELL0 and protected P-/GND are distinct nodes; the blocked ISDT/J102 service path must never become an accepted charging mode.
A419 is exactly one selected L-band GOES, H1, iO or active-patch assembly per profile, not four concurrently installed modules.
Exact source buses: LC76G GNSS uses Q6A UART6, Pico uses Q6A UART7, and the HMI I2C bus is Pico-local, separate from Q6A I2C0 and I2C2.
Catalogue-only optional items have no schematic reference. Related boundary references identify possible connection points and are not invented new A/U/J component numbers.

If a complete vendor wire protocol is absent from the available project evidence, keep that fidelity boundary NOT_SPECIFIED/UNMODELED. Do not substitute assumed SCPI, HID reports or guessed register commands.
Generic ARM64 Linux/QEMU virt validates software integration; it is not a Radxa Q6A/QCS6490 peripheral, Hexagon HTP, GPU, USB PHY or PCIe signal-integrity emulator.

An NC source pin means no external wire in this schematic; it does not prove internal module isolation. In particular U510 downstream VBUS pads are internally common although outgoing VBUS conductors are omitted.
Preserve separate Q6A 3V3, Pico 3V3, IMU 3V3, LAB5, VCC_5V_PERI, LIME3V3, chassis and protected/raw battery domains; do not merge nets merely because their nominal voltage or names look similar.
The E4 NT401 chassis-to-GND bond is an explicit component, not permission to alias every chassis and signal-ground node. Switched E4_DCS_RETURN is also distinct from GND.
Lime X1 remains permanently loaded and TX API paths blocked. Modeling receive samples does not qualify a transmit-disable implementation or create a transmission test.

sheet_hardware_gates.description: MPN L/C і діодів обрані. Ефективна ємність, ESR/ESL, демпфування LC та від’ємний викид OUT залежать від розведення і реальних деталей.

Статичне вікно OVP LNB закрито TPS3701: 13.56–13.96V. Швидкий викид при відмові LDO не обмежено гарантованим максимальним часом у даташитах: 9.9µs компаратора і близько 12µs EN-off eFuse задані лише типово.

source_notes: VSYS receives LAB5 through a Schottky diode. Module VBUS is reserved for USB programming or fallback H1. Never bridge VBUS to LAB5; connect USB only with the main switch on or LAB5 isolated.
Remove factory R7 before fitting the external 200 ohm ADC_VREF feed and LM4040C30. Battery ADC divider belongs to E1. ADC inputs must remain below the 3.0V reference.
Before Q6A 3V3 is present, put UART TX, SAFE_BOOT and service outputs in high impedance. This schematic relies on verified firmware sequencing; it does not claim hardware isolation.

All26 exposed GPIOs are assigned: GP17 physical22 now drives the MCP hardware-reset actuator, not brightness. No free Pico GPIO remains. GP23/24/25/29 are module internal and allthree external ADCs are assigned.

Required firmware behavior, not implemented firmware: assert GP17 high early at boot; maintain or assert it on missing/invalid UART heartbeat or unsafe shutdown; hold until an explicit qualified recovery/re-arm sequence. Program safe OLAT=0 and IOCON.ODR/MIRROR before re-enabling outputs and interrupts.

A sustained low on common MCP RESET makes allinternal expander output drivers high-impedance. Recipient pulldowns then disable their power branches, select HMC00 and turn relays off. It also resets allMCP fault history, which software must log before intentional reset where possible.
Brightness remains DDC/CI or a separately documented future KEY interface through an available MCP GPIO. GP17 is committed to watchdog reset.

catalogue_source_index.historical_part_label: - **Part:** GPIO expanders x2 (D13): #1 at 0x20 drives the enables; #3 at 0x22 reads FAULT/PG/sense inputs, with GPA7/GPB7 as outputs. They sit on Q6A I2C2 (pins 27/28, 100 kHz, behind the UM3204H), with INT mirrored open-drain to pin 5. Both run from the Q6A 3.3 V rail, have 100k pull-downs on every line, and are driven by labd through smbus2.
catalogue_source_index.historical_chosen_label: - **Chosen:** 2x genuine Microchip MCP23017-E/SO (SOIC-28 wide), bought from DigiKey (authorized) in the DigiKey order the stack already places, and fitted on the stack's own 2-layer power PCB (the 'Власні PCB' line, still at model status). Per chip: 100 nF at VDD plus 10 uF bulk; RESET through 10k to the Q6A 3V3 net; A2..A0 hard-tied (000 = 0x20, 010 = 0x22, no resistors); INTA/INTB mirrored open-drain to header pin 5. Add one DNP pair of footprints for 10k SDA/SCL pull-ups. Keep the existing 100k pull-downs on the same board. VDD comes only from the Q6A header 3.3 V net, never from a board-local 3.3 V. FALLBACK: if the power PCB is already frozen or ordered, or the bench conditions below fail, KEEP the Adafruit 5346 x2. No cheaper ready-made module was shown to be not-worse.
